parameters.command: SESSIONS_FILE=/tmp/claude-telegram-sessions.json; JOBS_FILE=/tmp/claude-telegram-jobs.json; echo '{"sessions":'; if [ -f "$SESSIONS_FILE" ] && [ -s "$SESSIONS_FILE" ]; then cat "$SESSIONS_FILE"; else echo '{}'; fi; echo ',"jobs":'; if [ -f "$JOBS_FILE" ] && [ -s "$JOBS_FILE" ]; then cat "$JOBS_FILE"; else echo '{}'; fi; echo '}'

={{ $json.deleteSession ? 'SESSIONS_FILE=/tmp/claude-telegram-sessions.json; TMP=$(mktemp); jq \'del(.["' + $json.chatId + '"])\' "$SESSIONS_FILE" > "$TMP" 2>/dev/null && mv "$TMP" "$SESSIONS_FILE" || true; echo "Session cleared"' : 'echo "No delete needed"' }}
